The moon message has MSGTYPE=stop, so pline.c vpline() calls display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE, TRUE), which returns at once because WIN_STOP shares WIN_CANCELLED's bit; the tutorial menu follows with no second --More--. The space is ignored by the menu and n declines.
